prompt: Create ORIGINAL standalone T-shirt chest artwork on a truly transparent background, NOT a shirt mockup. First two rows warm ivory medium size, third row about 1.65 times their letter height, CAR: ivory and WRONG. burnt orange. Make all three rows visually share one compact text-block width through deliberate typesetting, not stretching. A tiny simplified ivory line icon BELOW the text: antique curved-top cabinet with two doors and bottom drawer next to an obviously undersized hatchback, with a small burnt-orange hanging price-tag shape on cabinet. Just clean silhouettes/lines, no ground, no shading, no street, no people, no market signs. Icon contributes less than 18% of graphic height. No enclosing rectangle, no badge, no arch, no shadows, no gradients, no distress. Garment will provide negative space. About 1.2:1 wide-to-tall graphic, wearable compact chest composition. No text except the three exact phrases. Restrict art to warm ivory and burnt orange solid inks, no black background.
